dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #Heya, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Why'd you come find me out of the blue? Miss me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: You have mountains, and bodies of water, food and fun, and everything to like!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Besides, you're so kind to me. I really do love it here.

choices.text: I'm happy when I'm with you.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, really? Come, come, lend me your ear so I can tell you a secret.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Truthfully, I feel the same way.

choices.text: Isn't it about time you invited me over?

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Well, sure I can! If going to the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor won't scare you silly.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: As long as I'm not busy, you're welcome any time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Oh, perfect timing! I was just looking for someone to talk to when you appeared. You don't have telepathy, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: *sigh* Aiya, aiya, no one's as considerate and kind as you are!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #So... what do you want to talk about, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I want to hear you explain some mysterious phenomena.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: How can words suffice? Hmm... In this world, seeing is believing.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: If you have the courage, you can come with me on a stroll in the mountains one night to see for yourself.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Is your heart pounding? Wanna go? Hee-hee, then it's settled~

choices.text: I want to hear about your recent works.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Oh, you mean my poems, right? Ahem. It's been forever since I performed in front of someone. One sec... Get ready!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: "There perched two birds on a tree, one swooped down and caught a mouse, you see. In the mouse's mouth was a sprout, clinging to a seed, no doubt, so that little plant got to fly for free."

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: How's that? Give me your thoughts.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You really have such amazing literary talent.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Right? I knew you'd have a discerning eye to appreciate my poetry.

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Ah, I'm so happy I could die! You're such a fantastic friend!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hmm... something I want to do... I already do what I want every day.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: So today, I won't tend to any of that other nonsense. I'll just hang out here.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Your place has mountains and bodies of water, food and fun, and I get to hang out with you... How wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really like this place.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Well it's not just the place, silly... I mean lots of places have courtyards and pavilions! Why would I like the place, of all things?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hmm let's see... what else is there to like? Well, of course it's... it's... guess!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hee-hee! That look on your face... I'll stop teasing you.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: I like hanging out with you. And the fact that you're here with me proves that you like hanging out with me too!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: Hee-hee, no matter what you say, I'm staying here today and no one can drag me away!

response.speaker: Hu Tao
response.text: We have such a good relationship, so... surely you won't mind?

choices.text: You really don't mean what you say, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Hu Tao.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Morning~

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Look at how full of life you are! Must've slept like the dead last night, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Hu Tao.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: #Hehehe... good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Rest early and don't worry about nightmares, monsters under your bed, or anything like that.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: If such a thing happens, I'll settle it myself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: There's an old saying in Liyue: "a bed that faces the door... shall be haunted by a ghost of horror."

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: But as long as I'm here, you won't have anything to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: And if a couple of ghosts do come, you could invite them to play a game! Hmm... actually, why don't we put a table and some chairs in here? Hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: ...The atmosphere in the village is great. I've gotten some poetic inspiration just walking around!

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Ooh, do you think we'll see anything interesting after nightfall? Like... a statue coming to life, or an eerie fire underwater...

dialogues.speaker: Hu Tao
dialogues.text: Hehe... you'll join me, right?
